description: Send your numbered drawings (PNG, WebP or JPEG, 2 to 48 images, in name order), a zip of those images, or a sprite sheet with its column and row counts. The site assembles a single strip; the frame rate (6, 8, 12 or 24 frames per second) is set wherever you place it.
